record.label: Q24 manual rho-power runtime component
record.summary: The immutable 7d0c9e30... successor changes only Q24 rho-power construction to an explicitly left-associated native-out recurrence. Independent exact-byte source audit proved parent-bitwise canonical and official-He behavior, poisoned-arena overwrite, and the corrected exact projection of 2,131,280,786,389 FLOPs and 7,208 calls. Its separately released literal full-shape meter passed finite with zero failures at that exact bill (96.919429% of 2^41), 25.132427 seconds wall, 24.164065 seconds backend, 0.377093 seconds residual, and 4,767,105,024 bytes descendant RSS. Against the identical parent fixture, wall fell 13.9954% and backend time fell 14.7794%, while residual rose by 0.082601 seconds. This is a target-free bit-equivalent runtime component; it supplies no raw-MSE, tail-repair, package, board-distribution, or submission claim.
